papers.title: When Do Foundation Models Pay Off? A Break-Even Analysis of Pretrained Time Series Forecasters
papers.what: Measures the task-data threshold at which a pretrained time-series foundation model beats XGBoost and ARIMA across 30 datasets, and distills a training-free rule: series under 700 points with seasonality should use the foundation model zero-shot.

papers.title: Forecasting Realized Volatility with Time Series Foundation Models: A Comparison with Econometric Benchmarks
papers.what: Finds that zero-shot time-series foundation models do not uniformly beat the HAR econometric family on realized volatility once per-asset loss ratios and scale recalibration are used; only Tiny Time Mixers wins, and narrowly.

papers.title: TurnOPD: Making On-Policy Distillation Turn-Aware for Efficient Long-Horizon Agent Training
papers.what: Adds turn-level rollout-depth and turn-normalized loss budgeting to on-policy distillation so deep decision turns are not starved, improving accuracy-per-wall-clock on ALFWorld, WebShop, and Multi-Hop Search.

papers.title: PointDiT: Pixel-Space Diffusion for Monocular Geometry Estimation
papers.what: A plain ViT diffusion transformer that denoises raw 3D point-map patches in pixel space conditioned on DINOv3 tokens, beating latent-diffusion baselines without a point-map tokenizer.
